docs.title: Recommendation letter template
docs.body:
Dear Admissions Committee,

I am writing to recommend [STUDENT NAME] for admission to [PROGRAM]. I have known [STUDENT NAME] for [DURATION] as [RELATIONSHIP].

[STRENGTHS — two or three specific examples of their research, with what they did themselves]

[CLOSING — how they compare with other students I have worked with, and my overall recommendation]

Sincerely,

Ada Okafor
Associate Professor, Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences

docs.title: Jordan Lee — CV
docs.body:
Jordan Lee
jordan.lee@example.edu

Education
B.A. Psychology, expected 2027. GPA 3.9.

Research
Research assistant, Okafor Lab, 2024–present (two years). Built the preprocessing stage of the Halcyon analysis pipeline and wrote its test suite.
Independent project: sleep and working memory in undergraduates (n = 84), supervised by Ada Okafor.

Presentations
Poster, Society for Neuroscience annual meeting 2026: "Sleep fragmentation predicts working-memory lapses".

Teaching
Undergraduate teaching assistant, Introduction to Statistics, 2025.

docs.title: Jordan Lee — statement of purpose
docs.body: I am applying to the Neuroscience PhD program at Northwood University to study how sleep shapes memory consolidation. In the Okafor Lab I learned to build analysis pipelines that other people can trust...
